get.description:
Episode stills and titles plus a wide picture, from ani.zip. Separate from the details so
the page never waits on it; empty when ani.zip has nothing or is down.

Which sources can play this title. Separate from the details so a slow scraper never
holds the title page back.
What friends finished watching lately; friends who keep it private are left out.

post.description: Asks to be friends. If they already asked you, this accepts their request.

delete.description: Declines a request sent to you, or takes back one you sent.
Back to the default: the linked MAL picture, or the user's initial.

put.description:
Sets the picture from the raw image bytes (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB). The server
crops it to a square and stores a 256 px WebP.

get.description:
Finds someone by exact username. Name and picture are public to members, so a request can
go to the right person.
A profile is for the person and their friends only; anyone else gets a 403.

put.description: Remembers the source and sub/dub the user picked for this title.

get.description:
Without `u`, the master playlist of the episode the token is for. With `u`, one
playlist, segment, subtitle or image that an earlier response linked to (signed for the
signed-in viewer, who must send their bearer token, as the web app's proxy does).

Every source and sub/dub that lists this episode, in fallback order, for the player's
source menu. A source that is slow or failing is left out.

get.description:
Server-sent events: `state` (the whole room), `playback`, `chat`. Opening this joins the
room; closing it leaves.

post.description: Invites a friend to a room you are in. They get a notification.

put.description: The host switches everyone to another source, or between sub and dub.

get.description:
Opening, ending and recap times from AniSkip for a copy `length` seconds long. The
player asks once it knows the length, and fills in what the source didn't give.
